caption: The drawing features a single, detailed depiction of a Western-style saddle positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The saddle is rendered in sepia tones and includes intricate tooling and decorative patterns along its main surfaces, especially on the fenders, seat, and saddle skirt. Two saddle straps hang down from each side, and the cantle and horn are distinctly shaped, with the horn rising vertically at the front. The tooling consists of leaf and geometric motifs covering most of the leather sections. The saddle is unmounted, and no other objects or background elements are present besides the artist's signature, "FRANK C. SHAFFER" in the lower right corner.
title: Side Saddle
